systems.system: FOUTA electronic payment platform for public revenue
systems.owner: Ministère des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public
systems.tiers: all public revenue, including sundry proceeds recovered for the State, local authorities and public establishments; public administrations must integrate their recovery procedures, by order of 22 May 2026

note: An order making FOUTA the only channel for paying public revenue, local authorities' proceeds included; it is a legal obligation on a revenue application and states no connection at any local government office.
